name: dockula
description: ClaudeDockula: a dock of live panels for Claude Code.

plugins.name: claudedockula
plugins.description: Live panel tabs above the prompt that open docks of panels on the right or at the bottom. Built-in panels: Branch, Checks, Activity, Jira, GitGud (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) and Slacker (opt-in); add your own.
